title: Unbounded proper coefficient comparison and restricted projection identity
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-asd-proper-finite-coefficient-extension, for every unbounded derived input L the canonical scalar mate is an isomorphism, and its restriction of scalars agrees with the ordered proper projection morphism after the canonical scalar/tensor, pullback and direct-image comparisons.

source.place: Tag 0GL6, proper case; Tags 0B56 and 0D6E for the counit mate and direct-image comparison.

proof.text: Reuse the proved ambient calculation scalar_projection_ambient in Sheaf.Paper.EtaleProperCoefficientTensorUnit (available through a proof-only import all). It applies the generic restricted-mate identity to the normalized scalar/tensor pullback square from lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection. The square is established on flat-term K-flat models and extended by localization; no boundedness witnesses are used. This gives U(scalarMate) followed by the restriction/direct-image comparison as the canonical projection conjugated by scalar/tensor isomorphisms.

Reuse proper_scalarMate_isIso from the same module. The inverse scalar/pullback mate is invertible by lem-sfb-etale-proetale-scalar-mate. The iterated-mate identity makes the restriction/direct-image comparison invertible. The finite-coefficient proper projection formula makes the right side of the ambient calculation invertible. Cancel the direct-image comparison, then use homology and conservative ordinary restriction of scalars to conclude IsIso of scalarMate for every unbounded input.

For the ordered projection identity, expand functoriality of direct image and substitute the ambient calculation. Cancel the target scalar/tensor inverse against its hom and cancel the source scalar/tensor inverse against its hom inside direct image. The remaining maps are exactly the two signed symmetries and the specified coefficient-pullback projection composite in the conclusion. Pair this equality with the preceding isomorphism result.
